uses.n: The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi

512-5475-7066.easyPrerequisites: Avatar Kyoshi and Forensic Researcher do not have summoning sickness.
512-5475-7066.description:
Activate Avatar Kyoshi by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Forensic Researcher and Avatar Kyoshi, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-5475-7066.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Avatar Kyoshi's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

147-3085-4247.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-3085-4247.description:
Cast Zombify by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Zombify.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Zombify
Resolve the Zombify copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-745-1619-4865.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-745-1619-4865.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Mirrorhall Mimic and Vesuvan Shapeshifter each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mirrorhall Mimic trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Vesuvan Shapeshifter trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-745-1619-4865.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

215-5711-6633.description:
Activate Fanatic of Rhonas by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Fanatic of Rhonas from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Fanatic of Rhonas by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1303-1769-3967.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Rot Hulk enters, it and Necroduality trigger.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Rot Hulk.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, failing to return anything to the battlefield.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger, creating a token copy of Rot Hulk.
When the token Rot Hulk enters, it triggers, returning Rot Hulk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2921-4681-6542-7747.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Giant-Sized Flying Ant, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Giant-Sized Flying Ant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Giant-Sized Flying Ant enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

955-2440-6737-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Barret's triggers, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token.
When the Rebel enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Rebel you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Rebel token.
Activate the Rebel by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
955-2440-6737-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Rebel.

423-765-1437-6628--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-765-1437-6628--85.description:
Cast PuPu UFO by paying {2}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the PuPu UFO spell three times.
Resolve the first PuPu UFO copy.
Activate the PuPu UFO's first ability by tapping it, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

560-2034-5220-6351-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
560-2034-5220-6351-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Teval triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

3995-5963-7287.description:
Activate Marvin using Transdimensional Bovine's ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Horseshoe Crab's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1233-3259-5223.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1233-3259-5223.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Squee as attackers.
Squee triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

225-539-2908-7069.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U} due to Tectonic Split.
Cast Dream Stalker by paying its mana cost.
When Dream Stalker enters as a land due to Ashaya, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Dream Stalker trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Repeat.
225-539-2908-7069.notes: Once you have infinite mana, Stone-Seeder Hierophant can either tap for {G} or untap other nontoken creatures and/or lands you control.

requires.n: Mana Dork or Mana Dork Creator

618-4222--140.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of the mana-producing creature with haste.
Activate the creature token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
618-4222--140.notes: The chosen mana-producing creature must tap to produce at least {U} and not be legendary. If it taps to produce multiple mana, you will net infinite mana of the type(s) produced.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a film counter on it

57-4846-4885-6924.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-4846-4885-6924.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Peter Parker's Camera by paying {2}, tapping and removing a film counter from it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2292-3661-4053-6989.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

141-2511-5260.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2511-5260.description:
Cast Entering by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Entering.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Entering, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Entering copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-2511-5260.notes: You can cast Breaking and Entering fused together to also get infinite mill and self-mill.

1965-2835-5220.description:
Cast Omarthis by paying {0}.
Omarthis enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Fecundity.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Omarthis from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Fecundity trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Omarthis from your library.
Repeat.

1085-2438-4053.description:
Cast Chronozoa by paying {3}{U}. It will enter without a time counter on it due to Solemnity.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Chronozoa.
When Chronozoa dies, it triggers, creating two token copies of itself that also enter with no time counters on them due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 2 using a token copy of Chronozoa instead.

1563-2457-3000-4927.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

2544-4893-6788.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand with the mana to cast it, including at least one colored mana.
2544-4893-6788.description:
Activate Solar Array by tapping it, adding {U} and causing the next artifact spell you cast this turn to have sunburst.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {U}, untapping Solar Array.
Repeat as desired.
Cast any artifact spell, triggering its sunburst ability an infinite number of times, either putting infinite +1/+1 counters on charge counters on the artifact.
2544-4893-6788.notes: This combo can be repeated whenever you want to cast an artifact spell. If needed as well, you can tap Solar Array for colored mana to use in casting that spell, assuming you do not want to continue the combo after the spell is cast.

2921-4215-6730.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sin.
When Sin dies, it and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Sin trigger, moving any counters from it onto another creature you control, and then shuffling Sin into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Sin and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.
2921-4215-6730.notes: In order to get infinite +1/+1 counters, remove as many counters as possible when Sin enters, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin as it enters. Those counters can then be moved to another creature when Sin dies.

687-4929-5641-5684-6298.notablePrerequisites: If Linvala is in your graveyard, you must have {3} available and three removable counters from creatures you control, ensuring to leave a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite and Basking Broodscale. If Linvala is in your hand, you must have enough mana to cast it.
687-4929-5641-5684-6298.description:
Cast Linvala by paying its mana cost if it is in your hand. Otherwise, activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control, causing you to mill three cards and return Linvala from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
When Linvala enters the battlefield, Metastatic Evangel triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite and Basking Broodscale and a vigilance counter on Linvala.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a vigilance counter on it.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing both vigilance counters from Linvala and another counter from a creature you control.
Holding priority, activate Linvala by sacrificing it.
Resolve the Tayam ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Linvala from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
Repeat.
687-4929-5641-5684-6298.notes: If you do not control any other creatures, you may instead activate Tayam before sacrificing the Eldrazi Spawn, thus using the Eldrazi Spawn's vigilance counter as the third counter for activation. Doing this will add {1} to the mana needed for the combo.

997-4775-6553.easyPrerequisites: Necrogen Communion attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
997-4775-6553.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1525-1976-5751-6504.description:
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, putting a land from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library and causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Cast Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land.
Repeat.

5686-5972-5973.easyPrerequisites:
Griffin Guide attached to another creature you control.
You control an additional creature beyond those included above and the one that has Griffin Guide attached.
5686-5972-5973.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature with Griffin Guide attached.
When the creature dies, Cass and Griffin Guide trigger.
Resolve the Griffin Guide trigger, creating a 2/2 Griffin creature token.
Resolve the Cass trigger, returning Griffin Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

147-3645-5686.description:
Cast Black Sun's Twilight by paying {5}{B}
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Black Sun's Twilight.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Black Sun's Twilight
Resolve the Black Sun's Twilight copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2557-2933-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Scions by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1621-2897.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Gigantoplasm.
1621-2897.description:
Cast Gigantoplasm by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Gigantoplasm enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Gigantoplasm. Choose to have Gigantoplasm enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

2665-4863-4872.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Revolutionist.
2665-4863-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Revolutionist.
When the token Revolutionist enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

144-2438-5434.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2 greater than the largest life total among your opponents.
144-2438-5434.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, its first ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
Yarus' second ability triggers, returning Ashcloud Phoenix from your graveyard to the battlefield face down, and then turning it face up.
Ashcloud Phoenix's second ability triggers, dealing 2 damage to each player.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2034-5003-5029.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Knight of Sorrows, adding {C}{C}.
When Knight of Sorrows dies, its afterlife ability and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Knight of Sorrows trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Knight of Sorrows from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

386-1819-2503.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least ten creature cards in your graveyard.
Glistening Oil attached to Syr Konrad.
386-1819-2503.description:
Cast Inverter of Truth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Inverter of Truth enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling your library and then shuffling your graveyard into your library.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card that left your graveyard this way, giving each opponent that many poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

182-2749.notablePrerequisites: You have the highest life total.
182-2749.description:
Activate Wall of Blood by paying 1 life, causing it to get +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat step 1 until Wall of Blood's power is equal to the highest life total among your opponent.
Activate Jarad by paying {1}{B}{G} and sacrificing Wall of Blood, causing each opponent to lose life equal to Wall of Blood's power.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

690-1738-5070.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is higher than or equal to an opponent's.
690-1738-5070.description:
Cast Serra Avatar by paying {4}{W}{W}{W}.
Serra Avatar enters the battlefield, triggering Angelic Chorus, causing you to gain life equal to Serra Avatar's toughness.
Sanguine Bond triggers, causing target opponent whose lifetotal is less than or equal to Serra Avatar's toughness to lose life equal to the life you gained.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

950-3478-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Fatestitcher does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Fatestitcher.
950-3478-3525.description:
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{B}.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Dimir Aqueduct.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Fatestitcher.
Repeat any number of times.
